17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 2103 West Eastwood Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: = _RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 2,583.36 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is keeping the existing residential building containing three
(3) dwelling units. The existing building measures around 38 ft. in height.
Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and
Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the rear setback from the
required 20.7’ to 3.85’; reduce the west side setback from 2’ to 1.95’; waive
the required rear yard open space of 67.92 SF to zero and all relief
necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 2,867 square feet (1.11 FAR)

(B) _ The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 861.12 square feet per D.U.
(3 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 0 (existing)

a. Front Setback: 11 feet-6 % inches
db. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 6-5”
West Side; 1.95”
c. Rear Setback: 3.85”
